product_metadata.title: SunAngel 350 Pcs Fall Artificial Maple Leaves - Assorted Colors for Halloween, Fall Weddings & Autumn Parties Decoration
features: LIFELIKE LOOK - 350 assorted artificial leaves include 7 colors. The color is similar to real maple leaves in autumn. Easily converge with outdoor environment naturally, charming and elegant.
DURABLE FOR YEARS - Made with durable and eco-friendly polyester material, smooth to the touch and won't crinkle. And you don't need to worry about exposing them to wind, rain and sunshine

PERFECT FOR ALL OCCASIONS - This artificial maple leaves can be served as decorations for your wedding, festival, house, bars, party, banquet, stores or other occasions. And you have many usages: thread them and tie them to a tree, as wallpapers for sticking on the wall, write wishes on it as a card, serve as scatters for your wedding, accesories for flower girls, elements for all kinds of DIY for kids or yourself, or sew on your clothes
MORE CREATIVE IDEAS - Size ranging from 3 1/7" to 3 1/3" in width. And you can pick a handful of unified or mixed colors to create more fun, even when you want a little change to your hair
Warm Tip: The fall maple leaves may have a little smell when open package,expose the leaves for 1-2 days. The odor will be gone after that.Thanksgiving day is coming, are you ready for it?
description: 7 colors(350PCS) Artificial fall leaves in deeper Autumn. Made with high quality polyester, can be sticked, sewn with, threaded, scattered or written on with pens, can be served as decorations or scatters, durable for repeating use
